evidence.notes: Static SOQL projects toLabel() through a local alias readable by SObject.get.
Static SOQL projects FORMAT() through a local alias readable by SObject.get.
convertCurrency projects and filters local currency-shaped numeric fields.
convertTimezone composes with DAY_ONLY on local Datetime fields.
toLabel, FORMAT, convertCurrency, convertTimezone, and DAY_ONLY project named aliases locally.

source.content: @isTest private class QueryRuntimeSOQLSOSLSelectFunctionAliasesTest { @isTest static void selectedFunctionAliasesRun() { Account account = new Account(Name = 'Acme', Rating = 'Hot', AnnualRevenue = 100, LastSeen__c = Datetime.newInstanceGmt(2026, 2, 15, 10, 0, 0)); insert account; List<Account> rows = [SELECT toLabel(Rating) ratingLabel, FORMAT(AnnualRevenue) formattedRevenue, convertCurrency(AnnualRevenue) convertedRevenue, DAY_ONLY(convertTimezone(LastSeen__c)) seenDay FROM Account WHERE toLabel(Rating) = 'Hot Label']; System.assertEquals(1, rows.size()); System.assertEquals('Hot Label', rows[0].get('ratingLabel')); System.assertEquals('100.0', rows[0].get('formattedRevenue')); System.assertEquals(100.0, rows[0].get('convertedRevenue')); System.assertEquals(Date.newInstance(2026, 2, 15), rows[0].get('seenDay')); } }
